subject: Add static_assert to guard node flags fit in uint16_t (#4116)
reason: The change only adds a compile-time static_assert (and the CLUSTER_NODE_MAX macro it uses) to guard that cluster node flags fit in uint16_t. It alters no runtime behavior: no command, reply, replication, cluster-bus message, or persistence path changes. Any violation would be a build failure, not a testable server behavior, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise it.
